Units are unique interleaving histories / benchmark schedules with within-unit clustering declared; pooling repeated events as independent draws is refused (the task's registered negative control). Zero-event handling is one-sided Clopper-Pearson 1-0.05**(1/N), never a safety proof; RQ3 uses the frozen two-gate non-inferiority certificate with predeclared margins (token bytes <= +4096, p95 latency <= +10 ms, DB round trips <= +4). RQ2 requires real PostgreSQL 16 and declares SQLite stand-ins inadmissible. Denominator categories (eligible/attempted/completed/rejected/indeterminate/timeout/not_run_external/missing) predeclared in population_common. Paired contrasts: RQ1 B4-vs-B1 with B2 co-comparator, RQ2 B4-vs-B3, RQ3 B4-vs-B1/B2. Inferential machinery frozen to evaluation/venue2027/_shared/analysis_policy.py (exact McNemar, cluster bootstrap, Clopper-Pearson, ANALYSIS_DRIFT). No invented empirical results: regex gates refuse p-values/CIs/observed rates in the preregistration. 21 stdlib tests (positive + adversarial mutations refused: missing field, 4th RQ, per-event unit, SQLite-backed RQ2) pass; full ifip_sec suite 103 passed; ruff 0.7.1 clean.
